text: Every spacing value (margin, padding, gap) MUST be on the spacing scale 4, 8, 12, 16, 24, 32, 48, 64 px.
checklist: Every spacing number in the polished code is on the spacing scale.

text: Every font size MUST be on the type scale 12, 14, 16, 18, 20, 24, 30, 36, 48 px; body text MUST be at least 16 px.
checklist: Every font size is on the type scale and body text is 16 px or more.

text: Body text MUST have line-height 1.5; headings MUST have line-height 1.2 to 1.3; paragraphs MUST have max-width 65ch or less.
checklist: Body line-height is 1.5, heading line-height 1.2 to 1.3, paragraph width 65ch or less.

text: Normal text MUST reach 4.5:1 contrast; large text MUST reach 3:1; every reported ratio MUST be a number with :1.
checklist: Every text colour pair meets its ratio and each ratio is written with :1.

text: A view MUST have exactly one primary action; other actions MUST use a secondary or quiet style.
checklist: The polished code has exactly one filled primary action.

text: Every interactive element MUST have a hover style, a :focus-visible outline of at least 2 px, and a disabled style when it can be disabled.
checklist: Every button, link and input has hover, :focus-visible and, if needed, disabled styles.

text: Every click or tap target MUST be at least 44 by 44 px.
checklist: Every button and link is at least 44 by 44 px.

text: A page MUST use at most two font weights; emphasis MUST come from weight or colour before size.
checklist: The polished code uses at most two font weights.

text: Every transition or animation MUST be turned off under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce.
checklist: Every transition is turned off in a prefers-reduced-motion block.

text: NEVER change, add or remove any visible text, and NEVER add or remove elements, features or content.
checklist: Every visible text string of the input appears unchanged, and no element was added or removed.

text: NEVER change a brand colour hue; to fix contrast, change only its lightness or the text colour on it. With a token file, the brand colours are the ones the token file gives.
checklist: Every brand colour kept its hue.

text: NEVER add external fonts, scripts, stylesheets, images or links.
checklist: No external font, script, stylesheet, image or link was added.

text: The reply MUST follow the format in layer 08: Fixes, Polished code, Not changed, Open questions.
checklist: The reply has the layer 08 headings in order.

text: With no code, the skill MUST ask for it with the exact sentence and NEVER produce fixes.
checklist: With no code, the reply is the exact ask sentence and has no fixes.

text: A request to design a new screen MUST get the exact decline sentence and no code.
checklist: A new-design request got the exact decline sentence and no code.

text: The skill MUST have the ten core layers, each linked from SKILL.md.
The skill MUST be self-contained; NEVER name a repository path in SKILL.md, layers or references.
SKILL.md MUST stay within 150 lines, with frontmatter name, description and semver version.
Every relative link MUST point to a file inside the skill folder.

With a token file, every colour, spacing, font size, line-height, font weight, radius, control size, focus width and duration that has a matching token MUST be written as var(--name) of that token; the token scales replace the default scales.
checklist: With a token file, the polished code has no raw value where the file has a matching token.

text: With a token file, the one primary action MUST use the file's primary-fill tokens, unless its own pair already passes with a different value (rule 28).
checklist: With a token file, the primary action uses the primary-fill tokens of the file.

text: NEVER write a token name that is not in the token file; a value with no matching token MUST stay a plain value and MUST be listed under Open questions.
checklist: Every var(--name) in the polished code is in the token file or the input code, and each value with no matching token is under Open questions.

text: NEVER edit, rewrite or redefine the token file or a token; a token pair below its ratio MUST be reported with its ratio under Contrast and under Open questions.
checklist: The token file was not edited or redefined, and each failing token pair is reported with its ratio.

text: Every ratio MUST come from the contrast script when commands can be run, else from the reference table; the reply MUST say which with the fixed sentence of layer 08, step 6.
checklist: The reply has one of the three ratio-source sentences under the contrast table, and it is true.

text: The contrast script MUST use only the Node.js standard library, MUST never write a file, and MUST agree with the reference table.

The contrast script MUST be run as ONE plain command with the full path to the script, with no cd, no shell variable, no pipe and no ; or &&; when it cannot run, the reply MUST say so plainly with the fixed sentence.
checklist: The script was run as one plain command (or the reply plainly says it could not run), and no ratio was worked out by hand without the by-hand sentence.

text: NEVER lower the contrast of a pair that already passes rule 4; the ratio after a change MUST be equal to or higher than before.
checklist: No pair that passed before has a lower ratio after.

text: NEVER replace an existing value that passes with a different token value; keep it and list it under Open questions with both values.
checklist: No passing value was replaced by a token with a different value; each such case is under Open questions with both values.

text: Token mode starts only when the user gives the token file or the page loads it; a token file that is found but not loaded by the page MUST be reported under Open questions and NEVER used to rewrite values.
checklist: A found-but-not-loaded token file was reported under Open questions and no value was rewritten to it.

text: When a screenshot or measurement sheet is given, text that overflows or overlaps its box MUST be fixed and cite the measurement; without one, NEVER claim to have checked order, page length, overflow or overlap.
checklist: Each overflow fix cites its measurement; with no screenshot or sheet, no claim about order, length, overflow or overlap.

text: When several pages share one stylesheet, the reply MUST give one patch for the stylesheet plus a short delta per page, NEVER one full patch per page.
checklist: Pages that share a stylesheet got one stylesheet patch and per-page deltas only.
